typesense:popular.greeting:
*Don't find a Char that fit your interest? Don’t want to creates char on your own?
Don’t search further! You can create every story with this bot ✨*

*Tell the bot what roll he should play/ what the bot should do, and done! So easy to make your own story without a endless search 🔍*

*Check out my other bots! :]*
typesense:popular.name: Story Creator
